sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

However, as you progress through the game, the difficulty level increases, and you'll need to think strategically about which items to pack and how to arrange them. One of the most enjoyable aspects of Lunch Box Ready is its variety of items and recipes.
